title: 40-day-old girl with seizure
arrival: A 40-day-old girl is brought in by her parents after a seizure at home. She has had fever, cough, and a runny nose for three days. During the triage assessment, she is crying and feels warm to the touch. She is not actively convulsing.

checkpoints.why: No stridor, central cyanosis, or respiratory distress.
Her extremities are warm and capillary refill is normal. Her heart rate does not cross the high-risk threshold for her age band.
The seizure happened at home and she is not having active convulsions. She is consolable and interactive, with no altered mental status.
She is 40 days old — younger than 2 months — with a temperature of 40.5°C, above the 39° threshold.

keyCriterion: Red — Other: age <2 months with temperature <36° or >39°C
